fact: The Ministry of Digital Affairs and Digitalisation held a strategic seminar on 5-6 February 2026 as a milestone in drawing up Benin's digital strategy to 2031, work led by Deloitte, so a successor to the DPS is being drafted and not adopted.
title: Séminaire stratégique pour l'élaboration de la stratégie numérique 2031
publisher: Ministère du Numérique et de la Digitalisation
